spanish: E hizo dos querubines de oro; de martillo hizo a ellos desde los dos extremos de la kappóret.

findings.issue: מִקְשָׁה is a feminine singular noun (beaten/hammered work). "de martillo" names the tool and adds a preposition the token does not license.
הַכַּפֹּרֶת is a common noun with the article, not a proper name. "kappóret" leaves the lemma untranslated.

notes: Both qal 3ms verbs, the dual two, the 3mp object, and the plural ends match.
